blocking_finding.claiming_reason: experiments.minos_l2f_claim_next_job(plan_hash, worker_id) from 0007 is already plan-scoped and each authority supplies its own plan hash, so the queue never needed to know that phases exist.
blocking_finding.was: 0011 created experiments.l2f2_execution_authorities with phase IN ('PHASE_A') and canary_job_key NOT NULL, and l2f2_resolve_claimed_execution resolves with a hardcoded a.phase = 'PHASE_A'. A Phase-B plan could be derived, persisted and materialized but never executed.

checks.mypy: Success: no issues found in 224 source files

findings.action_taken: not changed under this task: the spec requires the existing role model to remain unchanged, 0011's bytes are immutable, and re-owning a live privileged function is a deliberate privileged change of its own. The NEW Phase-B resolver is owned by minos_admin, and that ownership is asserted.
findings.detail: experiments.l2f2_execution_authorities, l2f2_resolve_claimed_execution and l2f2_register_execution_artifact are owned by the login that ran 0011 (postgres on the real store), so both SECURITY DEFINER functions execute with SUPERUSER authority rather than the control plane's. 0008's writers are minos_admin-owned precisely to avoid this, and 0015 fixed the same class of defect before it shipped.
findings.remedy_requires_authorization: a migration issuing ALTER FUNCTION/TABLE ... OWNER TO minos_admin for 0011's three objects, with a privilege regression proving Phase-A execution is unaffected
findings.title: 0011's own objects are owned by the migration superuser, not minos_admin

phase_b_resolver_result_shape: identical to the Phase-A resolver; no additive column
racing_note: PHASE_B_BATCH0_ELIMINATION_EXPECTED = 0 is documentation, not a substitute for calling the frozen racing implementation. The control plane still calls eliminate().

revision_gates_audited.evaluation_path_note: no boundary in minos_engine.evaluation checks alembic_version, so migrating the active baseline to 0016 cannot break a legitimate evaluator operation.

tests.gatk_executions: FakeGatkRunner only, through the private test seam. No real GATK.
tests.phase_a_regression: the whole Phase-A path runs at 0016 in this regression: the 195-job screen in the Phase-B fixture, the runner-boundary suite, the canary-preparation suite and the 0015 migration suite all pass unchanged.
proven: empty lifecycle 0015 -> 0016 -> 0015 -> 0016 with full structural equality
0016 changes only the authority relation and adds exactly one function; no role, membership, schema-security, default-ACL or trigger moved, and no existing function was redefined
the added function is owned by minos_admin and is SECURITY DEFINER
PHASE_C, PHASE_D, validation, phase_b, TEST and '' are all refused
PHASE_A without a canary is refused; PHASE_B with a canary is refused; PHASE_B with none is accepted
one authority per (plan, phase) is still enforced
a populated Phase-A store (execution success + failure + jobs + authority) migrates with every scientific count and every Phase-A authority row unchanged
the downgrade refuses while a PHASE_B authority exists, before any schema mutation
EXECUTE on the Phase-B resolver: runner and admin yes; evaluator, trainer, live and PUBLIC no; no role gains any table privilege
a materialized Phase-B job cannot be resolved before its authority is prepared
preparation refuses when the derived plan is not persisted; is idempotent; and raises a typed conflict for each immutable field that disagrees
the Phase-B resolver resolves its own owned TRAIN job
the Phase-A resolver denies a Phase-B plan and the Phase-B resolver denies a Phase-A plan
the Phase-B resolver denies another worker's job, an unclaimed PENDING job, and a job of another plan
claiming is plan-scoped with three plans in one store, two of them holding PENDING jobs
one Phase-B job runs end to end under a minos_runner-only principal: claim, PHASE-B resolve, CLAIMED -> RUNNING, durable success, decided observation
Phase A is unmoved throughout, and racing still refuses a partial batch
